title: INVERTIBLE IMAGE DATASET PROTECTION
motivation: Companies fear stolen datasets used to train pirated models by competitors
problem_framing: Generate reversible adversarial images that remain adversarial even after defense processing
key_insight: Train the INN generator with a defense simulation layer so perturbations survive JPEG/blur/resize
method_signature: RAEG uses U-shaped invertible INN with DSAC blocks and ensemble classifiers, trained with defense simulation
evaluation_criteria: Classification accuracy drop on protected images; PSNR/SSIM; robustness under JPEG/ComDefend/DIPDefend
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: "there exist a trade-off between the adversary and the visual quality of the protected image"
evidence_for_taste: fixes the weakness of a fixed classifier
thinking_moves: 把对抗防御纳入训练过程而非事后补救
将可逆性作为一等公民而不是事后嵌入的水印
用INN的可逆性天然保证正向和反向操作一致性
用集成多个分类器防止攻击模式过于单一
